messages:
Maria (PM): quick sync — customer A pushed back: they want private deployment into their VPC with customer-managed routing and an explicit upgrade path from our hosted -> dedicated -> onprem package. need to decide MVP scope vs phase 2.
Jake (Eng Platform): thanks — high level: i think MVP should be: packaged onprem installer + vpc connector that supports static peering and security groups. full customer-managed routing + BGP/NAT traversal = phase 2.
Nina (Solutions): customer specifically called out desire to control egress routes and have their infra team manage NAT. they also want ability to roll back to hosted quickly if issues. we'll need clear migration playbook.
Owen (Security): must confirm KMS/HSM integration is not in MVP. need to bake in key placeholder hooks and documented requirements for air-gapped KMS in phase 2. otherwise we fail most enterprise audits.
Sarah (Customer Success): timeline note: customer wants a pilot within 8 weeks. if MVP doesn't include customer-managed routing they'll consider a proof-of-concept with limited scope.
Todd (Eng Runtime): feasibility: runtime can ship with network abstraction layer now. for MVP we'll support two modes: managed-routing (our recommended path) and passthrough (limited customer NAT). passthrough = no routing orchestration from our side, customers run iptables/NAT.
Jake (Eng Platform): ops constraints: packaging must support upgrades with zero-downtime KV-cache migration. proposals: 1) in-place upgrade with KV export/import, 2) blue/green with rollout traffic-split. prefer blue/green for safety, but more infra complexity.
Maria (PM): proposed decision items: [A] MVP = onprem installer + VPC connector (managed routing) + passthrough fallback for customers who insist on NAT control. [B] Phase 2 = customer-managed routing (BGP/NAT), HSM/KMS integrations, multi-region onprem replication. agree?
Owen (Security): +1 for deferring HSM to phase 2 as long as we require a formal security checklist for MVP. checklist items: enrollment auth, cert pinning, audit log export to customer SIEM.
Nina (Solutions): add: migration runbook for rollback must include sample commands. e.g.\n``\n# rollback to hosted\nredwoodctl migrate --to=hosted --dry-run\nredwoodctl traffic --route=hosted --percent=100\n```\nkeep it minimal for pilot.
DeployBot: deploy started: canary/onprem-pack-v1 -> dev-customerA (job 9832) :rocket:
Sarah (Customer Success): i'll tell customer we can do pilot with passthrough NAT and a clear rollback plan, but customer-managed routing will land in phase 2. that'll buy us time for BGP work.
Todd (Eng Runtime): action items: @Jake add blue/green rollout doc, @Owen draft security checklist, @Nina draft migration playbook + commands, @Maria confirm pilot acceptance criteria. i'll prototype KV export tool.
Maria (PM): accepted. pilot acceptance criteria (short): 1) successful canary for 48h under customer traffic, 2) rollback verified under <15m, 3) audit logs delivered to customer SIEM, 4) no critical perf regressions (>15% token latency). target: pilot sign-off in 6 weeks.
Jake (Eng Platform): noted. i'll add timeline to roadmap board and flag dependencies on infra for blue/green.
Sarah (Customer Success): i'll notify customer and ask for pilot window.
Maria (PM): thanks all — we'll reconvene next Tue 10am to confirm doc drafts. :calendar:
